entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane of inspired invention, formerly known as Kaladesh, whose life depends on aether and which is now united under the Avishkar Assembly.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: A raw magical energy critical to Avishkar's ecosystem and culture of invention.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: Avishkar's former governing body, which acted as an oppressive force trying to control aether technology and stifle innate magic.

entities.name: The Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: The new planar government that unites Avishkar after the revolution.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: A rebel group that thwarted the Consulate's plan.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: A race the Avishkar Assembly plans to resurrect to honor the plane's new beginnings.

events.summary: The Consulate is overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution, and Kaladesh is reborn as Avishkar.
events.quote: The ruling Consulate has been overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution.

events.summary: The plane is united under the new Avishkar Assembly, which plans to resurrect the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: The plane is now united under a new planar government called the Avishkar Assembly

events.summary: The Consulate announces a month-long fair that is secretly a deception to gather and control the plane's newest technologies.
events.quote: In truth, the Fair was a deception

events.summary: The rebel Renegades thwart the Consulate's plan, clearing the way for Avishkar's new beginnings.
events.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades

relations.note: The Renegades thwarted the Consulate's plan.
relations.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades
